svg.title: New York, NY
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study after an inspected primary museum photograph. Geometry approximate; vivid screen colour not calibrated. Six observed black angular regions on white rectangular ground; isolated triangles and edge contacts retained.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://buffaloakg.org/artworks/k195911-new-york-ny; source object K1959:11; inspected 2026-10-27; hand-authored approximation.
